tasks.subject: Task 1: Write AGENTS.md with taxonomy, tiers, and agent registry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the core AGENTS.md file with Sections 1-3 (Taxonomy, Capability Tiers, Agent Registry).

**Files:**
- Create: `AGENTS.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Taxonomy defines all 5 entity types
- [ ] Capability tiers table with Tier 1/2/3
- [ ] All 11 agents listed

**Verify:** `head -200 AGENTS.md`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AGENTS.md"], "verifyCommand": "head -200 AGENTS.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["taxonomy defines 5 entity types", "tiers table maps to models", "all 11 agents registered"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Cross-reference AGENTS.md against source code and update CLAUDE.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Verify AGENTS.md accuracy against source and add pointer from CLAUDE.md.

**Files:**
- Modify: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every tool in AGENTS.md exists in source
- [ ] Every skill file matches
- [ ] CLAUDE.md references AGENTS.md

**Verify:** `grep -c '@mcp.tool' src/agents4geosx/tools/*.py`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c '@mcp.tool' src/agents4geosx/tools/*.py", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tool count matches", "skill files match", "knowledge modules match", "CLAUDE.md updated"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
